flags: YAMAKAN_TRANSITIONS_OFF=1 refuses new or changed transitions (command, batch, save); stored ones stay, render and can be removed
deviations: The transition is stored on the incoming clip (with fromClipId naming its outgoing clip) rather than as a separate list of refs; adjacency is re-validated on every project
Named policy centeredDissolve/v1: an even number of frames centred on the cut, using source handles; clip times and the timeline length never change
One video dissolve (alpha k/D over the outgoing clip) and one sound option (equal-power quarter-sine crossfade, or a cut); titles, audio, retimed and animated clips are refused
Edits that would break a transition are refused (remove it first) rather than silently dropping it
Canonical v7 is written only for projects with a transition; an earlier build refuses v7
The interactive canvas shows a dissolve as a cut and the preview-parity notice names it

tests.result: 9 transition tests: golden boundary frames of a 10-frame dissolve in export and reference preview (exact A at frame 25 and exact B at 35 within 4 levels); equal-power level steady within 1.5 dB with both tones mid-crossfade and none under cut; persist/undo/redo/reopen, canonical round trip, v7 accepted and v8 refused, edit diff both ways, OTIO; refusals (zero, negative, odd and too-long durations, missing handles either side, longer than a clip, gaps, retimed, animated, locked, titles, sound fade at the cut, unknown clip); ripple refused not re-targeted, split rebinding, switch on command/save/editor recreate; loudnorm plan keeps the policy; 23.976 plan timing and a footage-into-still render with exact frames 18/24/30 and the exact extended sound length.
